EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows clear nitro signatures: a strong νs(NO2) near 1277 cm⁻¹ and an νas(NO2) around 1487 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-022). There are multiple N–H stretches in the 3212–3418 cm⁻¹ region and an N–H bend near 1627 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-002), consistent with an NH-bearing nitramine. A strong carbonyl band at 1694 cm⁻¹ fits a carbamate C=O, and intense aliphatic C–H stretches at 2943–2987 cm⁻¹ are present (GFQ-003). The 1002 cm⁻¹ band aligns with an N–N stretch typical of nitramines. Candidate 6 (an isopropyl carbamate with an N-nitro group) uniquely matches this combination of NO2, NH, and C=O features; candidates lacking NO2 or X–H bands are less compatible.
